payload.answer: my words will be recorded in the intent anyway, no?

options.description: Turning auto-approve on counts only where plumb finds your typed command in your private log; elsewhere it stays off. Turning it off is accepted from the record alone, since that's never unsafe.
options.label: "On" needs my words (Recommended)

options.description: Keep the new rule: a recorded "on" counts everywhere, even though an agent could write one.
options.label: Record alone is enough

payload.question: Turning auto-approve on is now accepted from its recorded entry alone wherever your typed words aren't present. But anyone can write such an entry, the agent included, even on this machine, since a forged entry has no words anywhere. Which rule should hold?
